review_method: Compare encoded START, MID and END pixels for every shot, then verify the generated renderer-position path has zero travel.

verified_repairs.result: 51/51 shot use one immutable generated crop position; no shot starts offset and recenters or pans between detector keyframes.
The award evidence uses one fixed crop instead of panning from the certificate to another person.
The detector identity switch from Joe to the band no longer creates a synthetic cross-frame pan.
The source cut between lecturer and audience retains one stable crop instead of chasing the detected face in each sub-shot.

residual_failures.reason: The source remains dark and visually abstract; this is a source-selection issue, not generated camera motion.
residual_failures.required_action: Prefer a face or immediately readable action in a future source-selection pass.

residual_failures.required_action: Score native source-camera and motion-blur risk before vertical crop planning.
